speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Tonic seizure lasting for 25 seconds. I also have Increasing lethargy over the past 18 hours, Appears ill. A doctor I saw earlier said this was very likely Pneumonia and told me the presentation was already quite typical.

speaker: Doctor
text:
That is an unusual finding for a 3-day-old neonate; pneumonia typically presents with respiratory distress rather than isolated tonic seizures. Did the mother have a fever or signs of infection (like chorioamnionitis) during labor or delivery? Also, have you noticed any jaundice, poor feeding, or bulging fontanelle?
